column1: # B57a — source of truth for the weyland-image CI build pipeline.
# Columns (TAB-separated):
#   image      registry repo name under registry.weyland.lab/  (matches scripts/build-push-images.sh)
#   context    buildctl context spec: "<dir>" (Dockerfile at <dir>/Dockerfile) or
#              "<dir>::<dockerfile-relpath>" (context=<dir>, Dockerfile=<dir>/<dockerfile-relpath>)
#   manifests  space-separated k8s manifests whose image tag tracks this build (lockstep — all move together)
# Paths are relative to nodes/mother/lab/weyland-platform/ (the platform dir), matching build-push-images.sh.
# ranger is version-pinned (not tag-following) and intentionally omitted — build via build-push-images.sh with RANGER_TAG.
# genre-trainer and finance-trainer (rogueone trainers, run by hand with `docker run`, deployed nowhere) are hand-tagged
# vN and intentionally omitted — build on the next free tag per runbooks/remote-training.md / finance-trainer.md.
# clef-flash (B174, rogueone's on-demand decision-model server, nodes/rogueone/services/gpu-inference/clef-flash/) is
# built locally by `docker compose up --build` from scripts/clef-flash.sh at each start and pushed nowhere — deployed
# nowhere in k8s — so it is intentionally omitted too (runbooks/decision-models.md § Compare Clef-flash).
# a2a-inspector (B17) is hand-tagged vN: v1 was built from github.com/a2aproject/a2a-inspector by hand; v2+ is the patch
# layer services/a2a-inspector/Dockerfile (FROM v1 by digest), built + pushed by hand like weyland-agent.
# weyland-jupyter (JupyterHub singleuser, B81) is tag-pinned (registry.weyland.lab/weyland-jupyter:vN, pullPolicy
# IfNotPresent) and built MANUALLY (bump the tag in k8s/jupyterhub/jupyterhub-values.yaml, then docker build/push)
# — the notebook library is git-synced not baked, so the image changes only on a dep/toolkit bump. Intentionally
# omitted from the tag-following CI loop, same as ranger. See runbooks/jupyterhub.md §2/§3.
# weyland-superset (B227 follow-on, 2026-10-24) is hand-tagged vN for the same reason as weyland-jupyter: the Superset
# chart takes image repository + tag as separate values keys, which the bump PR's registry/name:tag rewrite cannot see.
# Built on rogueone + push-image.sh from k8s/superset/image/ (runbooks/superset.md § The image).
# NOTE: feast-server + weyland-dagster-user-code share context services/weyland-dagster (different Dockerfiles);
#       weyland-flink + weyland-flink-py share k8s/flink — a change in the shared dir rebuilds both (conservative, correct).
